# Timeline

A film as tracks: `shots` run back to back with a transition between each (overlapping by its length); `overlays` sit above, placed by shot; `hits` put a sound on a moment. Each shot becomes a precomp layer named by its id (and a marker).

Shot fields: id, dur, start (locks a cut), in (transition into it), layers | src | comp | block (+vars), bg, speed (number or keys: a speed ramp), offset, move, camera, fx, layout

```json
{
  "timeline": {
    "hits": [
      {
        "at": "deep.start+0.8",
        "cue": "boom"
      }
    ],
    "overlays": [
      {
        "at": 0.5,
        "block": "lower_third",
        "dur": 2.5,
        "shot": "map",
        "type": "precomp",
        "vars": {
          "name": "Singapore"
        }
      }
    ],
    "shots": [
      {
        "dur": 3,
        "id": "hook",
        "layers": [
          {
            "align": "center",
            "pos": [
              960,
              540
            ],
            "role": "display",
            "text": "£827M",
            "type": "text"
          }
        ],
        "move": "push_in"
      },
      {
        "dur": 4,
        "id": "map",
        "in": "pan_out_left",
        "speed": [
          [
            0,
            1
          ],
          [
            1.5,
            0.3,
            "sine.inOut"
          ],
          [
            3,
            1
          ]
        ],
        "src": "map.png"
      },
      {
        "camera": {
          "deg": 24,
          "move": "orbit"
        },
        "dur": 4,
        "id": "deep",
        "in": {
          "dur": 0.8,
          "type": "zoom_through"
        },
        "layers": []
      }
    ],
    "transition": {
      "dur": 0.6,
      "type": "push_left"
    }
  }
}
```

## Transitions

| name | what it does |
| --- | --- |
| `cut` | no transition |
| `dissolve` | the next shot fades in over the last |
| `blur_dissolve` | a dissolve through a soft blur |
| `dip_black` | fade through black |
| `dip_white` | fade through white (a flash cut) |
| `dip` | fade through `color` |
| `push_left` | both shots travel left as one strip |
| `push_right` | both shots travel right |
| `push_up` | both shots travel up |
| `push_down` | both shots travel down |
| `slide_over_left` | the next shot slides in from the right over the last, which steps back and dims |
| `slide_over_right` | slides in from the left over the last |
| `slide_over_up` | slides up over the last |
| `slide_over_down` | slides down over the last |
| `whip_pan_left` | a camera whip pan with motion smear |
| `whip_pan_right` | a whip pan to the right |
| `pan_out_left` | pull back until both shots are tiles on one canvas, pan, push into the next |
| `pan_out_right` | pull back, pan right, push in |
| `pan_out_up` | pull back, pan up, push in |
| `pan_out_down` | pull back, pan down, push in |
| `zoom_through` | fly forward through the last shot into the next |
| `zoom_back` | fly backward out of the last shot |
| `cross_zoom` | a constant-speed dolly: both shots zoom at the same rate, the next arrives from far behind the last (no jump in speed at the hand-over) |
| `window` | the next shot is a rounded card (`portal`, `radius`) that opens like a window while the last zooms toward it, frame-in-frame |
| `iris` | a circle opens on the next shot |
| `flood` | a disc of `color` floods the frame, then opens on the next shot |
| `wipe_left` | a hard edge reveals the next shot from the left |
| `wipe_right` | a hard edge reveals the next shot from the right |
| `wipe_up` | a hard edge reveals the next shot from the bottom |
| `wipe_down` | a hard edge reveals the next shot from the top |
| `glitch` | a jittering, smeared, flickering cut |

## Shot moves

| name | what it does |
| --- | --- |
| `push_in` | a slow push in by `amount` (0.06) |
| `pull_out` | a slow pull out by `amount` |
| `drift_left` | the frame drifts left (scaled up by `amount` so no edge shows) |
| `drift_right` | drifts right |
| `drift_up` | drifts up |
| `drift_down` | drifts down |
| `ken_burns` | push in while drifting left |
| `handheld` | a gentle, deterministic handheld float |
| `punch` | a stepped punch-in on each time in `at` (a list), on a fast ease: the beat of a cut without a cut |

## Camera moves

| name | what it does |
| --- | --- |
| `orbit` | the camera circles the centre by `deg` degrees (30) |
| `dolly_in` | the camera travels toward the scene by `amount` of its distance (0.3) |
| `dolly_out` | the camera travels away |
| `dolly_zoom` | vertigo: travels in while the lens widens, the centre plane stays the same size, depth stretches |
| `crane_up` | the camera rises while looking at the centre |
| `crane_down` | the camera descends |
| `truck_left` | the camera slides left, looking straight ahead (parallax across depth) |
| `truck_right` | the camera slides right |
